services.name: Fin Whales
services.desc: Alaska is a place of extremes, boasting 17 of the highest peaks in America, the third longest river, and 100,000 glaciers, so it’s not surprising that the world’s largest creatures also call this place home. The state is one of the premier places to enjoy seeing whales at close quarters, and the best way to do this is on one of the whale tours offered along the Alaskan shoreline. Are you curious to discover more about where, when, and how to see whales on the Last Frontier? Read our comprehensive guide to whale watching in Alaska and start planning your visit to this natural wonderland.
